# Universal Editor Checklist

- Field names and labels match requirements.
- Required vs optional fields are correctly marked.
- Types/options/validation constraints are explicit.
- Conditional fields use `condition` and reference valid controlling fields.
- `classes` select is present where mode/variants are required.
- Block definitions/models/filters remain consistent.
- Definition template references the correct `model` and `filter` ids.
- Parent/child filter min/max and allowed components match intended authoring.
- `npm run build:json` executed after updates.
